columns.name: MODEL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Model Plan Id . This is the primary ley

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Id of the system.This is the foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Effective Date of the model plan.

columns.name: MODEL_PLAN_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the  model plan . The valid values are  DRAFT,PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED.

columns.name: MODEL_PLAN_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Model Plan Top Manager like Position or Line Manager

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Action Id. This is the foreign key to PER_ACTIONS_VL.

columns.name: ACTION_REASON_ID
columns.description: Action Reason Id. This is the foreign key to PER_ACTION_REASONS_VL

columns.name: AUTHOR_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Author's Person Id of the model plan.

columns.name: TOP_MANAGER_ID
columns.description: Top Manager Person Id  whose hierarchy is being modeled.

columns.name: TOP_MANAGER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Top Manager  Assignment Id  whose hierarchy is being displayed.

columns.name: TOP_MANAGER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Manager i.e LINE_MANAGER , RESOURCE_MANAGER , PROJECT_MANAGER

columns.name: ACCESS_TO_TOP_MANAGER
columns.description: The flag indicates whether the top manager can access the model. The valid values are Y/N and the default value is 'Y'.

columns.name: MODEL_LOADER_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the Batch loader process

columns.name: LAST_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Last Sync Date indicates the date of last synchronization to the Fusion System source

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
